# SQLite amalgamation

RapidBench vendors the official SQLite 3.53.4 amalgamation (`3530400`) so the
Storage Benchmark uses a fixed database engine across devices and builds.

- Source: <https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3530400.zip>
- SHA3-256: `628a44cfe82c66aed1ccbbe85a562d2e33ebe64b3288981ed76285612227934e`
- Files used: `sqlite3.c`, `sqlite3.h`, and `sqlite3ext.h`

SQLite is in the public domain. See the header of `sqlite3.c` and
<https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html>.
